The '''Wilds''' were an area of overgrown jungle and swamps on a [[Unidentified planet (Wilds)|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The Wilds was the habitat of the [[corvaj]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Ranna Gorjaye]] and [[Calson]] crash-landed in the Wilds following a training accident. Gorjaye survived, but Calson was killed by a corvaj.

==Behind the scenes==
The Wilds was first mentioned in the short text story ''[[Survival Class]]'' which appeared in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].

The planet on which the Wilds are located is never identified in the text, but Ranna Gorjaye's biography states that she received flight training on both the planets [[Salliche/Legends|Salliche]] and [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]],<ref name="tdc">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> indicating that the Wilds could be on either planet although there is no evidence in the story to suggest that this is case. The planet [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] is known to have an area called "[[The Wilds (Kiffex)|The Wilds]],"<ref name="legacy 34">[[Legacy (2006) 34|''Legacy'' (2006) 34]]</ref> however no source to date has established a link between the two locations.
